messages.body: I want help to notify of issues with payment. My card shows two charges of $59.99 on Oct 15 for order O-60080. Please remove the extra one.

text: category billing: Customer was charged twice for order O-60080 and requests a refund for the duplicate charge.
Policy lookup needed to confirm eligibility and process for refunding a duplicate charge on order O-60080.

args: {"k":3,"query":"Policy for duplicate card charges (charged twice) on a single order and refund process for the duplicate charge: eligibility, required approvals, and steps to issue the refund."}

passages.title: Duplicate captured payments
passages.text:
POL-BIL-02 v1.1: Duplicate captured payments
Conditions: Two or more payment records are captured against the same owned order, and their total exceeds the verified order total. Verify that the excess is not a legitimate split payment or a correction already refunded. A pending authorization is not a second capture.
Rules: The refundable duplicate amount is the verified excess captured amount after prior duplicate-charge corrections. Keep the legitimate order payment intact. For two captures of 4,250 cents on a 4,250-cent order with no prior correction, the eligible correction is 4,250 cents. It requires exact Billing staff approval under POL-RET-02. If the duplicate is verified and approval is the only missing requirement, use awaiting_approval. A successful refund receipt is required before saying the duplicate was refunded. The store currently records captures only. If later data adds pending authorizations, explain their recorded state without refunding an uncaptured amount or inventing a release date.
Exceptions: Unclear allocation across captures, a contested order total, another customer payment, or an open dispute requires Billing staff review. If the tool cannot associate a correction with the appropriate captured funds, pause execution for staff reconciliation.

passages.title: Partial refunds and billing corrections
passages.text:
POL-RET-06 v1.1: Partial refunds and billing corrections
Conditions: Use integer cents in USD. Read orders.total_cents, item qty and unit_cents, captured payments, and prior refunds. Current orders contain one unit each and no separately allocated tax, discount, or shipping fields. Do not invent additional monetary components.
Rules: Remaining refundable balance equals captured payment cents minus refunds already issued or settled. Apply that limit across all requests for the order. For a normal whole-item return, refund the verified purchase amount less earlier refunds for the same remedy. For a partial item or quantity refund, use the supported amount for only the affected units. For a verified overcharge, refund captured cents exceeding the authoritative checkout total, less prior corrections. Do not refund the legitimate charge. Duplicate captures use POL-BIL-02. An order paid at 13,999 cents with 4,199 cents already refunded has at most 9,800 cents remaining. An approval for 13,999 cents cannot be resized or reused for 9,800 cents; staff must reconcile it and provide an exact new approval.
Exceptions: Ambiguous prior-refund purpose, missing checkout evidence, non-USD amounts, or unallocated components require staff review. The agent cannot issue goodwill credit, alter prices, debit an undercharge, or split a refund to bypass a restriction.

passages.title: Cancellation and payment reversal requests
passages.text:
POL-ORD-01 v1.1: Cancellation and payment reversal requests
Conditions: Read the latest owned order.status and shipment record. An order with status processing and no shipment record can be cancelled with cancel_order; no staff approval is needed. cancel_order checks ownership and status itself and refuses shipped orders. It cannot intercept a shipment.
Rules: For an owned unshipped order, call cancel_order with the order ID. After a successful receipt, tell the customer the order is cancelled and the payment is reversed to the original payment method, quoting the receipt ID. The ticket can then be resolved. For a shipped order, explain that the agent cannot stop the shipment and that a delivered eligible item may use the 30-day return process under POL-RET-01. Escalate the cancellation or interception request to Billing staff. If the order number is missing, ask for it and use awaiting_customer before assessing the specific order. General cancellation guidance does not require an order number. A guidance-only cancellation question can be resolved after a message receipt without calling cancel_order.
Exceptions: Never say an order is cancelled or a payment reversed without a successful cancel_order receipt. If cancel_order refuses because the order has shipped, follow the shipped-order rule; other tool failures follow PO…
